retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait against a twilight coastal background featuring a prominent geometric sans-serif title overlaying the subject's torso.
triggerTerms: dusk beach portrait with large geometric text
low-key male portrait against purple sunset
coastal pier background with centered subject
excludeWhen: urban or indoor settings are requested
minimalist or small typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a centered male figure in dark clothing, set against a deep blue and purple twilight beach scene with a distant pier and a low setting sun, featuring large, thin-stroke geometric typography across the middle third.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography overlapping the dark silhouette of the subject
Color contrast between warm skin/sun and cool blue background
Horizontal horizon line bisecting the composition
coreInvariants: Twilight color palette (deep blues, purples, oranges)
Dark, textured clothing on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, filling approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright sun orb in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face down to the large display text, then across to the horizon and pier.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the sky and the lower third of the beach sand.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and navy blue (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale yellow and orange (sun and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-key value with high saturation in the blues; high value contrast on the text.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright daylight greens or reds

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thin weight for display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast between a thin display face and a bold, smaller sans-serif subtitle.

preserve: Thin stroke weight of main title
Contrast between title and subtitle weights

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and thin stroke weight.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp vertices.
Suitable for the heavy lowercase subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A centered medium shot of a man in a dark navy sweater standing on a beach at dusk. The background features a deep blue ocean, a purple-hued sky, a distant wooden pier, and a small glowing orange sun near the horizon.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a very thin, cream-colored geometric sans-serif font across the center. Add a smaller, bold, white lowercase subtitle justified to the right side below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the main text thin and geometric?
Is the subject centered and wearing dark clothing?
Does the background feature a twilight color palette?
Is the subtitle bold and lowercase?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Original artist name and album title

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subject and background via color

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Ensure the sun is a distinct, glowing orb.
Verify the thin font is legible against the dark sweater.
Confirm the horizon line is straight.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Portrait + Twilight Beach + Thin Geometric Type Overlay
